verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax calculates tax automatically on payments. The closest evidence to background automation is automated US filing, but that runs through a third-party TaxJar integration rather than a Stripe Tax capability. The pack documents no user-configurable automations, schedules, or background workflows that Stripe Tax itself lets a user set up, so the evidence is adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
